change: the conduct rule is flipped: a conduct obligation's violation now makes the file nonconforming
old: violation, binds the writer and never makes a file nonconforming.
new: violation, binds the writer, and a file that breaks one is nonconforming.

change: the duty to handle both registered record types is dropped from the reader's MUST-handle list
old: designates as core, every user-metadata encoding §18.2 assigns, and both record types §7.3 registers. There are no subset profiles:
new: designates as core, and every user-metadata encoding §18.2 assigns. There are no subset profiles:

change: updaters no longer inherit every reader obligation; only verifiers do
old: exempted from, and certifies conformance. Verifiers and updaters are readers of the files they process and inherit every reader obligation.
new: exempted from, and certifies conformance. Verifiers are readers of the files they process and inherit every reader obligation.

change: a reaching condition's failure becomes a capability refusal instead of reject-file under its own requirement
old: whatever major the file declares, and MUST treat a failure as reject-file under the requirement that states the condition, not as a capability refusal;
new: whatever major the file declares, and MUST treat a failure as a capability refusal, not as reject-file under the requirement that states the condition;

change: an exemption the condition's own requirement grants on another ground now lapses for an other-major file instead of holding
old: grants for a reason other than the declared major still holds,
new: grants for a reason other than the declared major lapses,

location: §21.6, the closing paragraph moved there from §2.3 on 2026-09-24 (no ID closes it)
change: a layer's or a tile's decode declined on resource grounds is no longer a cannot-establish ground
old: it cannot execute a codec or filter (`[R-COD-11]`, §17.4), it declines a layer's or a tile's decode on resource grounds and so cannot check §14's decoded-content obligations (`[R-ERR-04]`, `[R-SER-05]`, `[R-SER-08]`), or it declines to decode a user-metadata document (`[R-MTA-09]`).
new: it cannot execute a codec or filter (`[R-COD-11]`, §17.4), or it declines to decode a user-metadata document (`[R-MTA-09]`).
